runtime.algorithm: SHA256 of sorted <sha256><two spaces><relative POSIX path><LF> records

scope: Pages-shaped actual iframe; controlled providers/fonts/location and 1x clock from 2026-10-07T20:30Z. Not live providers or physical GPS.

last.model: V5 nominal lunar-Lambert / grey finite Earth; not calibrated spectroscopy

quality.method: 64/256 full + ambiguous-source minimum1024 + selected4096/8192; local display-change criterion
quality.scope: angular-rule discriminator; independent dense-reference, spatial, terrain and photometry errors are separate

scene.geometryConvention: display-bounded canonical Sun-angle buckets; native UTC unchanged

moon.calendarProxy: native below-horizon display token .020×material; not physical irradiance

composition.cloudTransmissionOwner: 1 - native painted alpha after native blur and vertical mask
composition.order: gas-transported sky → calendar direct-light cutout → native PBR material → native cloud screen → one shared encode
composition.cloudColour: display-referred native painter; inverse shared tone map; not measured cloud radiance
composition.exposureOwner: CP7 sky+diffuse meter before calendar/foreground; native foreground excluded
composition.saturation: native code 255 uses 1 - 1/131072 in inverse tone map

qa.earthshine: PBR earthshine (es curve in renderMoonPBR) — ashen, never black
qa.reason: below horizon → calendar ghost, moonlight off
